Result records per-item outcomes and supports resume/cancel; acceptance is not whole-profile success.

Shared ProfileRunner resumes a resumable run, rechecking remaining items and clearing an earlier cooperative cancellation request. Completed items are not blindly repeated. Package steps retain terminal authorization; inspect the resulting per-item states.

API v1 uses a journal transaction ID from history. Shared undo refuses nonundoable or already-undone transactions and later value/file edits; successful readback marks the original undone. It can restore inherited defaults. No dry-run; no general rollback promise for runtime actions.

Unversioned launch <catalog-id> [--yes] opens the exact catalog destination. JSON reports opened/message, not changed settings or helper completion. Consequential routes require --yes. Native pages use their listed provider operations for headless work.

Unversioned compat accept explicitly acknowledges all changed helper fingerprints and the current Hyprland version after user review. This is a policy change, not compatibility validation. Ordinary setting requests do not authorize automatically accepting drift.

Shared Iconic migration restores its recorded handover only while recorded paths still match. Later edits and conflicts are preserved. Unversioned text result; no claim that the desktop visually rendered the integration.

Versioned installed icon pack inventory reports XDG search roots, locations and incomplete discovery; unversioned list output remains available.
Shared four-sample lookup exposes paths, originating packs and inheritance without decoding or rendering images.
Window navigation, presentation keys, file-picker location, and transient notices; no standalone persistent setting.
